Delhi government plans to convert Kejriwal's former residence into guest house

The Delhi government is considering converting Arvind Kejriwal's former residence, referred to as the 'Sheesh Mahal', into a state guest house. The plan involves potentially hiring a private hospitality firm to manage and maintain the property. This repurposed bungalow would then be available for visiting ministers and government officials to use for a fee, aiming for revenue generation.
